Returns severity, whether they can usually be taken together, the mechanism, precautions and a link to the full

tools.name: medicine_info
tools.description: Look up an Indian medicine by brand or product name (e.g. Dolo 650, Crocin, Augmentin 625) and get its composition, category, company and reference price in INR, plus the GoDavaii page with uses, side effects and alternatives. Read-only; no data is stored.
